contexts.text: Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver () = redemption; for to weigh silver = to buy; and, in the spiritual sense, to redeem.

To weigh the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance () = that the celestial things of love and charity are from the Lord, and that He alone disposes their states. ( = to subordinate all things and keep them in equilibrium. AE 629:10.)
Tekel, or weighed in the balances () is predicated of good. ( = to know its quality as to good. AR 313:2.) ( = estimation in accordance with their quality, and Judgment. AE 373:3). AE 376:23.
Everyone takes his portion from the common stock.
How the viscera draw (from the stomach) their assigned portion.
Every object takes its portion from this common influx.
The payment of wages to workmen (a private duty of charity).
